title: "Daniel"

# Daniel

::: {.book-summary}
## Book Summary Insight

Daniel demonstrates God's sovereignty over earthly kingdoms through faithful servants living in exile. The book teaches that God's kingdom ultimately triumphs over every human empire.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 1

<div class="key-verse">Daniel 1:8</div>

<div class="identifier">Daniel purposed in his heart</div>

### Why This Verse

Defining verse of Daniel's faithfulness

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Daniel's resolve to remain faithful in Babylon. The key verse highlights unwavering obedience despite cultural pressure.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 2

<div class="key-verse">Daniel 2:21</div>

<div class="identifier">He changes the times and the seasons</div>

### Why This Verse

God's sovereignty over history

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts Nebuchadnezzar's dream of successive kingdoms. The key verse reveals God's eternal kingdom that will outlast all earthly powers.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 3

<div class="key-verse">Daniel 3:17</div>

<div class="identifier">Our God whom we serve is able to deliver us</div>

### Why This Verse

Faith in the fiery furnace

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the fiery furnace and God's deliverance. The key verse demonstrates faithfulness to God regardless of consequences.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 4

<div class="key-verse">Daniel 4:35</div>

<div class="identifier">None can stay His hand</div>

### Why This Verse

Nebuchadnezzar's confession

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes Nebuchadnezzar's humbling and restoration. The key verse emphasizes God's sovereignty over human rulers.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 5

<div class="key-verse">Daniel 5:27</div>

<div class="identifier">Thou art weighed in the balances</div>

### Why This Verse

Writing on the wall

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Belshazzar's feast and Babylon's fall. The key verse demonstrates that God judges pride and irreverence.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 6

<div class="key-verse">Daniel 6:10</div>

<div class="identifier">Daniel prayed as he did before</div>

### Why This Verse

Daniel in the lions' den

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts Daniel in the lions' den. The key verse highlights steadfast faithfulness and God's power to save.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 7

<div class="key-verse">Daniel 7:14</div>

<div class="identifier">His dominion is an everlasting dominion</div>

### Why This Verse

Messianic kingdom prophecy

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contains Daniel's vision of four beasts. The key verse points to the everlasting kingdom of the Son of Man.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 8

<div class="key-verse">Daniel 8:14</div>

<div class="identifier">Unto two thousand and three hundred days</div>

### Why This Verse

Major prophetic verse

### Chapter Insight

This chapter presents a vision of future empires and conflicts. The key verse demonstrates God's control of history before it unfolds.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 9

<div class="key-verse">Daniel 9:24</div>

<div class="identifier">Seventy weeks are determined</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the most studied prophecies

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Daniel's prayer and the prophecy of the seventy weeks. The key verse emphasizes repentance and God's redemptive timetable.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 10

<div class="key-verse">Daniel 10:12</div>

<div class="identifier">Fear not, Daniel</div>

### Why This Verse

Heavenly encouragement

### Chapter Insight

This chapter reveals spiritual conflict behind earthly events. The key verse highlights God's encouragement to those who seek Him.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 11

<div class="key-verse">Daniel 11:32</div>

<div class="identifier">The people that do know their God shall be strong</div>

### Why This Verse

Frequently quoted encouragement

### Chapter Insight

This chapter details future kingdoms and struggles. The key verse demonstrates the accuracy and certainty of God's prophetic word.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 12

<div class="key-verse">Daniel 12:3</div>

<div class="identifier">They that be wise shall shine</div>

### Why This Verse

Resurrection and reward

### Chapter Insight

This chapter concludes with promises of resurrection and final deliverance. The key verse offers hope beyond suffering through God's ultimate victory.
:::
